evidence.quote: This is a 3.5-year program consisting of 7 academic semesters.
All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year
The application deadline in the self-financed procedure is 15th June.
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform - that you can reach here:
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based).
an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.
passing a written and oral entrance exam in Mathematics and Physics.

note.fr: Fournir un certificat de fin d'études secondaires et passer un examen d'entrée écrit et oral en mathématiques et en physique.
note.en: High school certificate required and passing a written and oral entrance exam in Mathematics and Physics.

evidence.quote: Admission requires a high school certificate; an English Placement Test with an Oral Entrance Exam and passing a written and oral entrance exam in Mathematics and Physics.

note.fr: Payer des frais de candidature de 150 USD et des frais d'examen d'entrée de 350 USD.
note.en: Pay application fee of 150 USD and entrance exam fee of 350 USD.

evidence.quote: Application fee: 150 USD Entrance exam fee: 350 USD
